title: 2010 UP844 Whistle
author: Rvassar
changes: A real steam locomotive whistle, 'toot, tooooot!': Union Pacific steam engine 844 passing through Kosse, Texas. Trimmed to 25.80–28.70 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
